req.title: Create new player
req.statement: The system shall create a player and respond with HTTP 201 when POST /players/ receives a valid Player payload.
expected_outcomes: Location header points to new resource

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that a valid player creation request should result in a 201 Created response with a Location header pointing to the new resource. Tests are designed to cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_create_new_player_success
preconditions: The player with squad number 27 does not exist in the database.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a valid PlayerRequestModel payload.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

player_data = {
    "firstName": "John",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01",
    "squadNumber": 27,
    "position": "Forward",
    "abbrPosition": "FW",
    "team": "Test FC",
    "league": "Test League",
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=player_data)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.headers['Location'] == "/players/squadnumber/27"

tests.name: test_create_new_player_conflict
preconditions: The player with squad number 1 already exists in the database.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a PlayerRequestModel payload having squad number 1.
expected: The response contains a conflict error message.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

player_data = {
    "firstName": "Jane",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Smith",
    "dateOfBirth": "1992-02-02",
    "squadNumber": 1,
    "position": "Midfielder",
    "abbrPosition": "MF",
    "team": "Test FC",
    "league": "Test League",
    "starting11": False
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=player_data)
assert response.status_code == 409
assert "A Player with this squad number already exists." in response.json()['detail']
